purpose: Teach: あめ/サヨナラ/ミーハー/ひとみ/られよ/スキップ/バツ/下敷き

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがあめ細工の職人さんとお話されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad had a conversation with a candy craft artisan.
lines.style: Warm, sharing something observed about him. Gentle curiosity in the voice. Slight pause before speaking, like recalling a tender moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんにサヨナラと言うのは寂しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, it makes me sad to say goodbye to Dad.
lines.style: Small, careful voice. The hurt is real but held quietly. No drama — just honest weight. Eyes down slightly, trusting her to understand.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ミーハーな憧れだけじゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, just admiring from afar isn't enough, you know.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. Not scolding — guiding. Like she's inviting him to look deeper. Warm undertone beneath the directness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんのひとみが優しいって思うよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think your eyes are kind.
lines.style: Quiet observation, genuinely offered. No self-consciousness. The words are simple but they carry real feeling. Steady gaze, unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「健やかにあられよ」と仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said, "May you stay healthy and well."
lines.style: Reflective, almost reverent. Holding his father's words carefully. Slight warmth — the blessing mattered. Paced slowly, like she's honoring what was said.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、楽しくてスキップしちゃったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got so happy I skipped!
lines.style: Bright burst of joy. Unguarded, unfiltered. The energy of a child who can't contain delight. Quick pace, genuine laughter underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、宿題にバツが付かないように頑張ろうね
lines.en: Sho, let's work hard so you don't get marks wrong on your homework.
lines.style: Encouraging, matter-of-fact. Not anxious — practical support. The tone says: I believe in you, and I'm here. Light, steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの下敷きをお借りしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I borrowed your ruler, by the way.
lines.style: Casual, apologetic-bright. A small admission wrapped in trust. Knows she won't be upset. Warm but efficient, like he's checking in.
